From 1b3023ef54d4fc8e8a034d2178ef80bddd7ba206 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Mauro Carvalho Chehab <mchehab+huawei@kernel.org>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2020 08:40:55 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] docs: ABI: sysfs-c2port: remove a duplicated entry

As warned by scripts/get_abi.pl:
	Warning: /sys/class/c2port/c2portX/flash_erase is defined 2 times:  Documentation/ABI/testing/sysfs-c2port:60  Documentation/ABI/testing/sysfs-c2port:68

This entry was added twice at the same patch. Probalby a
cut-and paste issue.

Fixes: 4e17e1db9647 ("Add c2 port support")
Acked-by: Jonathan Corbet <corbet@lwn.net>
Signed-off-by: Mauro Carvalho Chehab <mchehab+huawei@kernel.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/4ea2b31ddc76161fbae004f2f2ed91dfb757703f.1604042072.git.mchehab+huawei@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/Documentation/ABI/testing/sysfs-c2port b/Documentation/ABI/testing/sysfs-c2port
index 716cffc457e9..f7b8cf6e4398 100644
--- a/Documentation/ABI/testing/sysfs-c2port
+++ b/Documentation/ABI/testing/sysfs-c2port
@@ -66,13 +66,6 @@ Description:
 		the "erase" command on the on-board flash of the connected
 		micro.
 
-What:		/sys/class/c2port/c2portX/flash_erase
-Date:		October 2008
-Contact:	Rodolfo Giometti <giometti@linux.it>
-Description:
-		The /sys/class/c2port/c2portX/flash_erase file show the
-		on-board flash size of the connected micro.
-
 What:		/sys/class/c2port/c2portX/reset
 Date:		October 2008
 Contact:	Rodolfo Giometti <giometti@linux.it>
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: Documentation/ABI/testing/sysfs-c2port**
   - Removed a duplicated entry for `/sys/class/c2port/c2portX/flash_erase`. The entry was present twice in the documentation, specifically at lines 60 and 68. The removal was likely due to a cut-and-paste error when the entry was added in a previous patch.

### Relationships

- The modification addresses a warning generated by the `scripts/get_abi.pl` script, which indicated that the `flash_erase` entry was defined multiple times. This patch corrects that issue by removing the duplicate entry, thereby ensuring the documentation is accurate and adheres to the expected ABI format. The fix is linked to a previous commit (4e17e1db9647) that introduced the duplicate entry.
